_about: SIMULATED ASSETS. Nothing in this file describes a real object.
Open data has no register of small items such as planters, pot trays and rain barrels, so these stand in for them.
Positions were placed by hand near real roads and gardens so the map looks plausible. They are illustrative only.
The site marks every one of these as SIMULATED wherever it appears.
Fields: id, name, type (a key of [asset_types] in config/risk_config.toml), lon, lat.
Optional: holds_water, drain_time_h, water_source, flushable to override the type's assumption for one asset; note.
